mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced cost of capital for corporate investments.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% for three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending power and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) above their 12-month moving averages indicates robust consumer and housing demand, driving corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of RSAFS and HOUST above 12-month moving averages fails to predict positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 95 combined with CPIAUCSL between 220 and 230 indicates manufacturing sector expansion without inflationary pressure, supporting corporate profit growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales exceeding 400,000 (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending, which typically precedes corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS exceeds 400,000.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 1.0% for three consecutive months signals monetary tightening, increasing borrowing costs and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.0% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment (UNRATE below 5.0%) and employment growth (PAYEMS above 130,000) indicates a tight labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE below 5.0% and PAYEMS above 130,000 fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 700 (HOUST) combined with retail sales above 405,000 (RSAFS) indicates strong demand for goods and housing, supporting corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods meeting the trigger condition.
